notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 780 text/html captures under /SharedDocs/Reden/EN -> 267 kept. ENGLISH SIBLING of the German deu_bundespraesident_wayback (which harvests the ~11,785-capture /Reden/DE tree). These are the presidency's OWN official English translations, so text lands in the English column with NO machine translation. TITLE(#content h1 / h1.c-article__headline)/TEXT(#content / .c-article__content)/DATE all green; bodies 6.2k-22.8k chars (Wulff's 2010 inaugural address after taking the oath; Steinmeier at the Fifth World Holocaust Forum, Yad Vashem; '100 years of Latvia's constitution'), dates 2010-2025. WHY THE `\.html$` ANCHOR: of the 780 text/html captures only 267 end in .html - the other ~513 are the SAME pages captured with a ';jsessionid=' tail or a '?nn='/'?fbclid=' query string, and the engine de-duplicates by exact URL, so admitting them would scrape many speeches two or three times. Precision over recall was chosen deliberately (a duplicated speech corrupts the corpus; a missing one leaves a gap the German sibling already covers). WHY A DATE SELECTOR here and not the German sibling's url_regex alone: the 2021+ URLs dropped the /MM/ path segment, so a /YYYY/MM/ regex misses every speech from 2021 on (~113 of 267). Both templates carry a visible dateline (span.c-topline__element.is-date; span.date), with url_regex retained as a backstop - the probe confirmed BOTH paths firing. SCOPE NOTE: the German Federal President is largely CEREMONIAL; the Chancellor (bundeskanzler.de / bundesregierung.de/breg-en) is the head of GOVERNMENT and has no recipe yet - worth deciding before a full run.
